manifest.name: demo-bundle
manifest.description: Two demo policies. Members: demo-write-gate: blocks on an agent's file writes and at turn end; demo-shell-guard: refuses a matched shell command before it runs; demo-advice: advisory only. It is skill text, and nothing stops a violation. [Advisory skill only; enforcement needs chock installed in the repo.]
